director_resolution.additional_direction: Use a visibly different motion treatment when the context itself shifts.

reconciled_law.within_context_succession: F1A Tight remains the provisional shared-brand treatment for bounded eligible succession inside an already-established context.
reconciled_law.context_shift: A genuine context shift must not use F1A as its primary transition grammar; it requires a visibly different non-sequential treatment.
reconciled_law.single_event_ownership: One motion grammar owns one transition boundary. Context-shift treatment and F1A may not run concurrently or as automatic chained choreography for the same state change.
reconciled_law.later_f1a: After the new context is fully established, F1A may occur only at a later independently eligible succession boundary triggered by separate content/state/user logic; it is never owed after a context shift.
reconciled_law.state_truth: User input and authoritative state continue to outrank all choreography; stale motion is cancelled rather than completed for aesthetic continuity.
reconciled_law.reduced_motion: Reduced-motion preference preserves the same context and information with immediate final-state rendering and no identity-critical semantic loss.
